source_statement: Earlier Java search referenced a Baidu Wenxin Assistant plan/Python example. This revision rewrites discovery in C# using .NET APIs; original Python was not available or copied. Existing C# was read for API and integration compatibility, so this is not a legally certified clean-room process.
alpha_release_note: Chinese comments/documentation and release preparation only. Current hashes refreshed; original manifest archived. Historical rights statements unchanged; no new independent clearance.
local_only_final_note: Local-only revision: official Java MSI/default-directory discovery, .minecraft isolation and update UI integration. No new third-party source or icon geometry imported; historical qualifications remain.
